ns2:course.label: Special Research Problems
ns2:course.description: Individual investigations or research projects selected by the students, subject to approval by the graduate adviser and the executive officer of the Department. 1 to 8 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in the same or separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Enrollment in graduate degree program.
